name: T2I-Eval-Bench
description:
This is the human-annotated benchmark dataset for paper Automatic Evaluation for Text-to-Image Generation: Fine-grained Framework,
Distilled Evaluation Model and Meta-Evaluation Benchmark
NOTE: Please check out our github repository for more detailed usage.
evaluation_method: human_eval (mean opinion score), ranking correlation (e.g., Kendall/Pearson)
general_score_metric: mean human rating (MOS) and rank correlation
reputation: Human-annotated benchmark introduced alongside a paper on text-to-image evaluation; used by researchers developing and validating T2I evaluation metrics.
